commits.message:
modified FPGA charge sense to be compatible with BQ24125

simply remove the pin, as the passive pull-ups do the right thing.
The charge sense changed between DVT and PVT, so this change should
be "safe" across both generations.

Note that lots of files are checked in because windows sucks and
changed a whole bunch of file permissions, I don't know why it
decided to do that.

Merge pull request #3 from xobs/master

Re-work PWM patch
get HAS_DDR to work, and comment out DDR by default since we don't use it.
fix timing closure issue on motor 208MHz PWM clock domain

fix error in UCF file causing LCDO_G7 to be randomly mapped

Also improve red LED flashing and fix DDR2 reset bug

improve clock distribution and tie-down unused outputs

this is a clean-compile of the FPGA code, finally.

Adding an auto-generated file, ddr2_m3_core_v2, to fix xilinx bugs

Coregen creates the .ncf file for the DDR2 core with some odd
heirarchy for the constraints. A direct edit of the .ncf file was
employed to fix these bugs.

syntax clean and bug fixes to get to clean-compile

code now cleanly compiles and ports look properly hooked up.
on to testing!

syntax cleaning

Fixup of all the minor syntax errors. Now on to compilation...

Added motor controller interfaces

digital I/O, ADC, and motor PWM/servo PWM interfaces added.
Also, register bank expanded.

added DDR2 test interfaces

DDR2 test interfaces just use I2C commands to do simple read/write
to the DDR2 interface to validate that the interface can store and
recall data
add project file. Planahead 13.3 is the tool used.
